verdict.rationale: The agent-access half is well documented: an official MCP server, local and hosted, lets AI clients manage flags with natural language. The ldcli CLI manages flags from the command line, and scoped API tokens can restrict which operations an integration may perform. On the governance half, the approvals docs only say members have "the option to request approval" for a change. Nothing in the pack shows approvals can be made mandatory, or that they block API, CLI or MCP writes to production. missing for 10: evidence that approvals can be required and enforced on agent-initiated (API/CLI/MCP) changes, documentation that MCP or CLI changes route through approval requests, independent or hands-on corroboration.
